name: Kushala

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Soul Barb: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki her buff için saniyede enerji hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Spirit Rider
The pause for activating the Blessing with the fewest stacks lasts an additional +[1 - 5] seconds.
Kushala's Damaging Debuffs have a [2 - 9]% chance for each active Blessing to be replaced with matching Passives with 20% increased potency. This chance is doubled against Cosmic Opponents.
Kushala does not benefit from the Despair Mastery. Instead, she reduces the Opponent's Regeneration Rate by 8% for each Debuff or personal Damaging Passive active on them, up to a maximum of 100%. Each rank in the Despair Mastery increases this reduction by +4% and the maximum by +10%.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Kushala's connection to her Spirit of Vengeance grants her immunity to all Bleed and Incinerate effects.
All attacks deal Energy Damage.
Combat Power Rate is reduced by 20%.
Personal Damaging effects are paused during Kushala's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Hunter of Might
content: Light Attacks have a 40% chance to place an indefinite Ignition Buff on the Opponent. This chance increases by +20% flat if the Opponent is Soul Barbed. Max stacks: 10.
When the Opponent gains a Buff, Kushala Passively gains 2% of her Max Power.
Kushala does not benefit from the Mystic Dispersion Mastery. Instead, each rank increases the amount of power she gains on Buff activation by 10%.

abilitySections.title: Blessings of The Eagle - Max Stacks: 3 Each
content: Gain a Blessing of Wisdom when either Champion performs a Well-Timed Block, allowing Kushala to Block Unblockable attacks from non-Science Champions and Passively Regenerate 25% of the damage taken from Blocked hits.
Gain a Blessing of Justice when either Champion is struck by the first hit of a Heavy Attack, making the Opponent more aggressive and increasing the potency of Kushala's Damaging effects by 10%.
Gain a Blessing of Power when either Champion Intercepts their Opponent, increasing Kushala's Ability Power Rate by 15% and reducing the Opponent's by the same amount.

Blessings are not affected by Ability Accuracy. Each Blessing lasts for 12 seconds, plus an additional +15 seconds flat if activated while either Champion is performing or recovering from a Special Attack 1 or 2.
When activating a Blessing while both other Blessings have more active stacks, pause all Blessings for 3 seconds.
The Ability Accuracy of Kushala's personal effects and the Parry Mastery is increased by 35% for each unique Blessing active.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On the final hit, each Buff on the Opponent has a 50% chance to be Nullified. For each Buff Nullified, inflict an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [22,488] Energy Damage over 18 seconds.
Inflict 4 additional Incinerates if the Opponent is Soul Barbed or Degenerating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit consumes 30% of the Ignition Buffs on the Opponent to inflict a [562.2] potency Soul Barb Debuff for 15 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
This duration is increased by +0.75 seconds for each Buff consumed and for each Incinerate effect on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain one stack of each Blessing and place an indefinite Judgement on the Opponent, increasing the duration of Kushala's future Blessings by +4 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
For each active Blessing, inflict a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [11,244] Direct Damage over 8 seconds. Max stacks: 9.
